# hcloudplus_project (Resource)

A Hetzner Cloud project. Managed via the account-level private API.

## Example Usage

```terraform
resource "hcloudplus_project" "example" {
  name = "infra-prod"
}
```

<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Required

- `name` (String) Human-readable project name. Can be changed in place.

### Read-Only

- `created` (String) RFC 3339 timestamp of project creation.
- `id` (String) Numeric project ID, stored as a string to satisfy Terraform's ID contract.
- `owner` (Attributes) The account that owns the project. (see [below for nested schema](#nestedatt--owner))
- `role` (String) Caller's role in the project (typically 'owner' for projects created via this provider).

<a id="nestedatt--owner"></a>
### Nested Schema for `owner`

Read-Only:

- `email` (String)
- `id` (Number)
- `robot_cn` (String)

## Import

Import is supported using the following syntax:

The [`terraform import` command](https://developer.hashicorp.com/terraform/cli/commands/import) can be used, for example:

```shell
# Import an existing project by its numeric ID.
terraform import hcloudplus_project.example 14138093
```
